title: 第6章 好色如命
content_zh:
听赵硕这么说，赵鸾道：“前些日子大哥打渔回来的时候，听大哥说他如今已经修行到了灵窍期大圆满，周身各大筋脉已然全部打通，随时都有可能进阶到淬体期，比陈天贵还要厉害呢，大哥的资质、悟性，并不算太差，可惜的是传承星图太差，灵窍只有区区一重天，如此一来牵引元力其慢无比。(：)加上修行的时间晚了些，不然若是有好的星图传承的话，修行速度提升数倍，或许大哥如今已经有淬体期的修为了”

赵硕苦笑道：“那些世家子弟从小就开始修行，并且还拥有高等级的星图开启灵窍，许多人像咱们这么大的时候只怕都有淬体大圆满的修为了吧”

正在两人说话间，一个浑厚的声音从外面传来道：“二弟、小妹，快出来看大哥给你们带什么东西了”

赵鸾闻言欢喜的道：“是大哥，大哥回来了呢”

赵硕身上包裹着绷带从床上下来，还没有走出房间就见一肤色发黑，身体壮实无比的青年兴冲冲的走进房间，正是赵家兄妹中的老大，赵丰。

手中提着一串美丽的贝壳还有一些精致的小东西，赵丰看到包扎着绷带的赵硕的时候不禁愣了一下，紧接着脸上露出关心的神色，一把将将手中的东西放在一旁，快步走到赵硕的身边将赵硕上下打量了一番，似乎确认赵硕并没有什么大碍，这才松了一口气，怒气冲冲的道：“小硕，告诉大哥，这是怎么回事，是谁将你打成这样的，大哥非要好好的教训他们一番”

只从赵丰的反应，赵硕就能够感受到赵丰这位大哥对自己的那份真挚的兄弟之情，同样也看出赵丰性格直爽，是一个性烈如火的人，若是不将其安抚下来的话，只怕赵丰真的有可能提上鱼叉在陈天贵的身上捅出几个血窟窿来。

一把拉住赵丰，赵硕连忙道：“大哥，你回来了，这次出海收获如何？”

赵鸾拉着赵丰的另外一只胳膊，一双水灵灵的眸子盯着一边的贝壳还有其他的小东西，欢喜的道：“大哥，这些东西是买给鸾儿的吗？”

性子憨直的赵丰立刻就被赵硕还有赵鸾两人给转移了心思，咧嘴一笑道：“这次大哥出海可是大获丰收，竟然打了一网天星鱼，卖了近千星币呢，加上以往的积蓄，小硕，你可以进行星图传承开启灵窍了啊”

看着赵丰那副欢喜的模样，赵硕不禁心中一酸，看着满脸风霜的赵丰，尽管没有在大海上呆过，但是赵硕也能够想到海上的风险，而赵丰完全是冒着莫大的风险在为自家兄妹博取前程。

一千星币对于他们这样的普通家庭，一天一枚星币完全足够花销，也就是说三年的花销才能够从传承商人那里获得最低等的普通星图传承来开启灵窍。

见到赵硕发呆，赵丰兴奋的道：“小硕，是不是非常开心啊，放心吧，等大哥再有机会打到天星鱼就可以让小妹进行星图传承，到时候咱们兄妹都能够进行修行”

赵硕反应过来颤声道：“大哥，谢谢你！”

赵丰伸手在赵硕的肩膀上拍了一下，豪爽的笑道：“臭小子，和大哥有什么客气的”

一丝痛哼从口中发出，赵硕不禁伸手握住肩膀，赵丰呆了一下，一脸自责的道：“二弟，你怎么样，都怪大哥……”

痛意消去，赵硕摇了摇头道：“没事，只是一点小伤罢了”

赵丰看着赵硕身上的伤道：“告诉大哥，是不是陈天贵那小子又欺负你们了，竟然敢欺负我的家人，我扭断他的脖子”

赵硕同赵鸾见了不禁吓了一跳，连忙将冲动的赵丰拉住道：“大哥，你消消气，你可不能这么冲动，教训那小子很容易，可是咱们家不比陈家，他们与陈家主脉是有联系的，不像咱么家没有家族照应，若是大哥你出了什么意外，让娘亲怎么办”

赵丰一拳砸在墙上，顿时一个拳印出现在石墙之上，赵硕见了不由得松了口气，只听赵丰怒气难消的道：“难道就这么算了？”

赵硕眼中闪过一道寒光道：“算了，哼，哪里有这么简单，若是只是打了我一顿，那也就罢了，可是他竟然敢打小妹的主意，我非要让他明白有些人是不能招惹的”

赵鸾注意到赵硕眼中的寒光，心中一颤，这些日子赵硕身上的变化让早熟的赵鸾看在眼中，虽然有些惶恐，但是更多的却是心安，她相信不止大哥能护着她，以后二哥更能比大哥保护自己。

不过赵鸾却为赵硕担忧，毕竟陈天贵不比其他，他身后有这望海城三大家族陈家的影子，绝对不是他们这样的家庭可以招惹起的。

注意到赵鸾那担忧的目光，赵硕冲着赵鸾微微一笑道：“正所谓君子报仇十年不晚，总有一天我要让陈天贵为他的所作所为付出代价。”

赵鸾听了赵硕的话微微松了一口气，她可是切实的感受到这些天赵硕的变化的，以心智论，赵鸾知道以赵硕的心智绝对不会贸然对陈天贵出手的。

晚上的时候，赵丰与赵硕睡在一个房间之中，只听赵丰道：“二弟，明天大哥就带你去开启灵窍！”

出乎赵丰的预料，只听赵硕道：“大哥，暂时不用急，我想先随你去海上打渔，等有机会再开启灵窍”

愣了一下，赵丰道：“二弟，虽然普通星图传承差了一些，可是总比没有要强啊，若不是靠着开启灵窍的话，在大海上，许多风险大哥或许都过不去呢，那些高等级的星图传承没有天大的机缘根本就不可能获得的”

赵硕呵呵一笑道：“大哥，你想到哪里去了，我只是不想那么急着进行星图传承罢了。”

点了点头，赵丰道：“二弟，海上多风浪，海中更是多海兽，十分的凶险，再说你要是随我去海上的话，家里没有男子，万一陈天贵前来骚扰小妹，那该怎么办？”

眼中寒光闪烁，赵硕冷笑道：“既然如此，那就先将陈天贵这祸害给除掉，如此便可无后顾之忧了？”

赵丰吃惊的看着赵硕道：“二弟，你说什么，你要除掉陈天贵，白天的时候你和小妹不是说……”

赵硕看着赵丰那副惊讶的模样不禁笑道：“大哥，我和小妹阻止你是不让你那么光明正大的去找陈天贵的麻烦，这样是会给家里带来天大的灾难的，但是明的不行，咱们完全可以来暗的啊”

赵丰颇有些不敢相信的看着自信满满的赵硕道：“二弟，你是不是想出了什么办法来，快和我说说”

赵硕一阵轻声低语，赵丰的一双眼睛越来越亮，最后压抑不住的握紧拳头兴奋的道：“好，真是好主意，如此神不知鬼不觉，当真是天衣无缝”

没有过两天，赵硕与赵丰两人出海了，而赵家便只剩下赵鸾还有楚秀二人。

一直没有将赵鸾放下的陈天贵很快就从自己那一班狐朋狗友口中得知了这个消息，当即兴奋的两眼放光，一想到赵鸾那苗条的身段，白皙的肌肤，陈天贵就忍不住的狂咽口水，如果不是顾忌赵丰还有赵硕两人在家的话，陈天贵早就对赵鸾暗暗下手了。

明媚的阳光下，满是芬芳的花园之中，蜂飞蝶舞，胖墩似地陈天贵正靠在躺椅上，身边两名侍女俏脸布满红晕的给陈天贵按摩，几名小厮侍立在一旁，不过有其主必有其仆，几个小厮色*的盯着两名侍女凸凹有致的身段，表情极为不堪。
content_en:
Hearing what Zhao Shuo said, Zhao Luan said: "When my eldest brother came back from fishing a few days ago, I heard that he had reached the Great Perfection of the spiritual aperture stage. All the major muscles and veins in his body have been opened up, and he may advance to the body tempering stage at any time. He is even more powerful than Chen Tiangui. My eldest brother's qualifications, understanding, and...It’s not too bad, but it’s a pity that the inherited star map is too poor, and the spiritual aperture is only at the first level, so it is extremely slow to draw the energy (:) In addition, the time of practice is a little late, otherwise if there is a good star map inheritance, the practice speed will be increased several times, maybe the elder brother will have the cultivation level of the body tempering stage now.”

Zhao Shuo smiled bitterly and said: "Those children from aristocratic families have been practicing since they were young, and they also have high-level star charts to open their spiritual apertures. Many of them will probably have achieved the Perfect Body Tempering Dzogchen when they are our age."

While the two were talking, a deep voice came from outside: "Second brother, little sister, come out quickly and see what big brother has brought for you."

Zhao Luan heard this and said happily: "It's eldest brother, eldest brother is back."

Zhao Shuo got off the bed with his body wrapped in bandages. Before he left the room, he saw a young man with dark complexion and extremely strong body walking into the room excitedly. It was the eldest of the Zhao brothers and sisters, Zhao Feng.

Holding a bunch of beautiful shells and some exquisite small things in his hand, Zhao Feng couldn't help but be stunned for a moment when he saw the bandaged Zhao Shuo. Then he showed a concerned look on his face, put the things in his hands aside, and walked quickly to Zhao Shuo's side.After looking Zhao Shuo up and down, he seemed to confirm that there was nothing serious about Zhao Shuo. Then he breathed a sigh of relief and said angrily: "Xiao Shuo, tell big brother, what is going on, who beat you like this, big brother must teach them a lesson."

Just from Zhao Feng's reaction, Zhao Shuo could sense the sincere brotherly love that Zhao Feng had for him. He also saw that Zhao Feng had a straightforward personality and was a fiery person. If he was not calmed down, Zhao Feng might really use a harpoon to poke a few bloody holes in Chen Tiangui's body.

Pulling Zhao Feng, Zhao Shuo quickly said: "Brother, you are back. How was your harvest this time?"

Zhao Luan took Zhao Feng's other arm, staring at the shells and other small things on the side with a pair of watery eyes, and said happily: "Brother, are these things bought for Luan'er?"

Zhao Feng, who was straightforward and straightforward, was immediately diverted by Zhao Shuo and Zhao Luan. He grinned and said, "This time my eldest brother went to sea and it was a great harvest. He actually caught a net of star fish and sold it for nearly a thousand star coins. With the savings from the past, Xiao Shuo, you can pass on the star map and open the spiritual orifice."

Looking at Zhao Feng's joyful expression, Zhao Shuo couldn't help but feel sad. Looking at Zhao Feng with a weathered face, although Zhao Shuo had never been on the sea, he could still think of the risks at sea, and Zhao Feng was taking huge risks to gain a future for his brothers and sisters.

For an ordinary family like theirs, one thousand star coins a day is completely enough. In other words, it takes three years to obtain the lowest ordinary star chart inheritance from the inheritance merchant to open the spiritual aperture.

Seeing Zhao Shuo in a daze, Zhao Feng said excitedly: "Xiao Shuo, are you very happy? Don't worry. When the elder brother has another chance to catch the Sky Star Fish, the younger sister can pass on the star map. Then we brothers and sisters can all practice."

Zhao Shuo reacted and said tremblingly: "Brother, thank you!"

Zhao Feng reached out and patted Zhao Shuo on the shoulder, and said with a bold smile: "You brat, why are you so polite to me?"

A groan of pain came from his mouth, and Zhao Shuo couldn't help but stretched out his hand to hold his shoulder. Zhao Feng was stunned for a moment, and said with a look of self-blame: "Second brother, how you are doing is all your fault..."

After the pain subsided, Zhao Shuo shook his head and said: "It's okay, it's just a minor injury."

Zhao Feng looked at the injuries on Zhao Shuo and said, "Tell me, brother, did that boy Chen Tiangui bully you again? He dared to bully my family. I broke his neck."

Zhao Shuo and Zhao Luan couldn't help being shocked when they saw it. They quickly stopped the impulsive Zhao Feng and said: "Brother, calm down, you can't be so impulsive. It's easy to teach that boy a lesson, but our family is not like the Chen family. They are related to the main line of the Chen family. Unlike our family, there is no family care. If something happens to you, eldest brother, what will your mother do?"

Zhao Feng punched the wall, and a fist mark suddenly appeared on the stone wall. Zhao Shuo couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief when he saw it. Zhao Feng said angrily: "Is this the end of it?"

A cold light flashed in Zhao Shuo's eyes and he said: "Forget it, hum, it's not that simple. If he just beats me up, that's it. But he dares to take advantage of my little sister. I must let him know that some people cannot be messed with."

Zhao Luan noticed the cold light in Zhao Shuo's eyes and trembled in her heart. The changes in Zhao Shuo's body these days made the precocious Zhao Luan see it. Although she was a little scared, she felt more at ease. She believed that not only the eldest brother could protect her, but also the second brother would be able to protect her better than the eldest brother in the future.

However, Zhao Luan was worried about Zhao Shuo. After all, Chen Tiangui was no better than others. Behind him was the shadow of the Chen family, the three major families in Wanghai City, which was definitely not something that a family like theirs could provoke.

Noticing Zhao Luan's worried eyes, Zhao Shuo smiled slightly at Zhao Luan and said: "As the saying goes, it is never too late for a gentleman to take revenge. One day I will make Chen Tiangui pay the price for what he has done."

Zhao Luan breathed a sigh of relief after hearing Zhao Shuo's words. She had really felt the changes in Zhao Shuo these days. From a mental perspective, Zhao Luan knew that Zhao Shuo would never attack Chen Tiangui rashly.

At night, Zhao Feng and Zhao Shuo slept in the same room, and they heard Zhao Feng say: "Second brother, tomorrow I will take you to open the spiritual orifice!"

To Zhao Feng's expectation, Zhao Shuo said: "Brother, don't worry for now, I want to go fishing with you on the sea first, and then open the spiritual orifice when I have the opportunity."

After being stunned for a moment, Zhao Feng said: "Second brother, although the ordinary star map inheritance is a little worse, it is better than nothing. If it were not for opening the spiritual aperture, many risky brothers might not be able to survive on the sea. Those high-level star map inheritances would be impossible to obtain without great opportunities."

Zhao Shuo chuckled and said, "Brother, where are you thinking? I just don't want to be in such a hurry to inherit the star map."

Nodding, Zhao Feng said: "Second brother, there are many winds and waves on the sea, and there are many sea beasts in the sea. It is very dangerous. Besides, if you follow me to the sea, there is no man at home. What if Chen Tiangui comes to harass my little sister?"

With a cold light flashing in his eyes, Zhao Shuo sneered: "In that case, let's get rid of the scourge Chen Tiangui first, so that we don't have to worry about anything later?"

Zhao Feng looked at Zhao Shuo in surprise and said, "Second brother, what are you talking about? You want to get rid of Chen Tiangui. Didn't you and my little sister say during the day..."

Zhao Shuo looked at Zhao Feng's surprised look and couldn't help but smile: "Brother, my little sister and I stopped you from going to trouble Chen Tiangui so openly. This would bring huge disaster to the family, but if you can't do it openly, we can do it secretly."

Zhao Fengpo looked at the confident Zhao Shuo with some disbelief and said: "Second brother, have you come up with any ideas? Tell me quickly."

Zhao Shuo whispered softly for a while, and Zhao Feng's eyes became brighter and brighter. Finally, he couldn't hold back and clenched his fists and said excitedly: "Okay, what a great idea. It's so seamless without anyone noticing."

Within two days, Zhao Shuo and Zhao Feng went to sea, and only Zhao Luan and Chu Xiu were left in the Zhao family.

Chen Tiangui, who had never put Zhao Luan down, soon learned the news from his group of friends. His eyes immediately lit up with excitement. When he thought of Zhao Luan's slender figure and fair skin, Chen Tiangui couldn't help but swallow his saliva. If he hadn't been worried about Zhao Feng and Zhao Shuo being at home, Chen Tiangui would have secretly attacked Zhao Luan long ago.

Under the bright sunshine, in the fragrant garden, bees and butterflies danced. Chen Tiangui, who was as fat as a man, was leaning on a lounge chair. Two maids beside him massaged Chen Tiangui with their pretty faces full of blush. Several servants stood aside, but like every master, there must be a servant. Several servants looked at the two maids' curvy figures with lustful expressions.
